controls.title: 3D controls and active play
controls.setup: Use a safe outdoor area with several nearby creatures or objects, a short practice jump, and enough health/stamina. Keep movement and targeting defaults for the demonstration. Record short clips with key presses visible.

gear.title: Equipment, inventory and spells
gear.setup: Use a character with two gear choices, stackable supplies, an Ust, two expendable salvage materials, a usable spellbook/caster, and a vendor nearby. Save valuables outside the salvage batch.

world.title: World, party and character states
world.setup: Group location-dependent work together: a party member for trade/party, an owned or permitted house, an active contract, an outdoor death location when convenient, and your server’s barber service. These shots can wait until the relevant state occurs naturally.

setup.title: Launcher, setup and UI stills
setup.setup: Use sample server/account names. Hide passwords and personal paths. Choose a comfortable UI/text scale; frame the relevant panel closely enough that its controls are readable.

terminal.title: TUI gameplay and scripts
terminal.setup: Use a real terminal session with a prepared character and the shipped scripts. Show pane focus and the footer; choose a large enough terminal font for the final website size. All interactive TUI capture belongs to the user.

smart-tab.setup: Several eligible targets; show peace/combat stance and targeting preferences.
smart-tab.framing: Keep the target HUD, a few candidates and the key display in frame.
smart-tab.expected: A hold acquires a target; taps and Shift+Tab cycle; interaction/attack is a separate deliberate action.

jump-demo.setup: A repeatable, safe short jump with the landing visible.
jump-demo.framing: Show the character, target, trajectory and power bar together.
jump-demo.expected: The chosen preview and executed landing are visible in one continuous clip.

camera.setup: Open ground with a landmark to compare character facing.
camera.framing: Keep the character and landmark visible; label mouse buttons.
camera.expected: Orbit leaves facing alone; right-hold steers, and middle/both buttons move forward.

loadouts.setup: Two weapon/gear arrangements, with one slot intentionally omitted and an empty included slot.
loadouts.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Capture the builder, result icon/bar cell, and equipment changes; split into short steps if needed.
loadouts.expected: Included, omitted and cleared slots have visibly different outcomes.

spells.setup: Known spells in several schools/levels and an empty spell-bar cell.
spells.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Keep search, filters and destination bar readable.
spells.expected: A found spell is inspected and dragged to its bar, then used with the correct target.

hud.setup: Several HUD elements in a normal gameplay view; choose one small and one larger text size.
hud.framing: Two matched stills or one comparison image with the world visible.
hud.expected: Panel placement and UI/text scale differences are clear without cropping controls.

launcher.setup: A sample server/profile with account filled and password hidden.
launcher.framing: Frame server/profile choices, account and Play; omit private machine details.
launcher.expected: Readers can identify each step used by the connection guide.

content-picker.setup: First-launch folder selection with a complete retail DAT folder available.
content-picker.framing: Show the folder-level choice and enough file names to identify the correct directory; use a neutral path.
content-picker.expected: The reader can distinguish selecting the folder from selecting one DAT file.

tui-workflow.setup: Normal gameplay with nearby targets and carried items.
tui-workflow.framing: Keep dashboard, context and footer visible; record Tab focus changes.
tui-workflow.expected: Pane focus, tab selection and Assess results are legible.

tui-script.setup: A prepared fighter or mage, with appropriate supplies and a safe test encounter.
tui-script.framing: Show /scripts, /run, useful script feedback, and /unrun without long idle time.
tui-script.expected: The script starts, makes a visible decision, then stops so manual control resumes.

combat-controls.setup: A safe target, melee weapon and optional ranged weapon/ammunition.
combat-controls.framing: Crop to the curved combat HUD, keeping power/accuracy, attack height, play/pause and ammunition readable. Include only enough world context to connect the control to the attack.
combat-controls.expected: The new layout is recognizable, with adjustment and start/cancel shown in melee and missile stances.

locks.setup: A real locked chest/door, at least one key, trained Lockpick and a usable pick.
locks.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Show the locked object and helper; keep estimate and result text readable.
locks.expected: The key attempt and available lockpick action/result can be understood.

salvage.setup: Two expendable materials, including a stack; prepare but do not submit the batch.
salvage.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Close view of Items to salvage and Estimated output; retain all quantities.
salvage.expected: Whole-stack inclusion and separate material output rows are visible.

vendor.setup: A nearby vendor, enough currency, one purchase and one expendable sale.
vendor.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Show stock, queue quantities, balances and Trade feedback.
vendor.expected: A reviewed purchase/sale completes and the resulting balances/items are visible.

player-trade.setup: A consenting second player with a small sample offer on each side.
player-trade.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Frame the whole trade window with both participants and confirmation/reset controls.
player-trade.expected: Both offers and acceptance states are readable; no valuable exchange is required.

character-progression.setup: A character sheet with a trainable skill and an affordable improvement quote; do not buy unintentionally.
character-progression.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Show the skill and cost, with a second still for the Train confirmation.
character-progression.expected: Immediate improvement cost and separately confirmed training are distinguishable.

waypoints.setup: An outdoor character and open World map/chat.
waypoints.framing: Show command input, coordinate link and map pin without a full-screen chat zoom.
waypoints.expected: Set a waypoint from chat coordinates; show its world map pin and minimap direction and distance while traveling, then clear it.

housing-payments.setup: A house crystal with a real purchase/maintenance requirement and suitable carried items.
housing-payments.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Show eligibility/payment rows and Auto-fill; stop before payment unless desired.
housing-payments.expected: Prepared amounts and remaining requirements are readable.

housing-access.setup: An owned/permitted house and sample guest entries.
housing-access.framing: Show Access & guests with separate entry/storage controls and names safe to publish.
housing-access.expected: Entry permission is visibly separate from storage permission.

journal.setup: An in-progress or repeatable contract with a contact/quest location.
journal.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Show filtered contract details, a timer and its map destination; use two stills if needed.
journal.expected: Progress/timing and the useful destination are clear.

corpse-recovery.setup: A naturally available outdoor death location and recoverable nearby corpse; no deliberate death required.
corpse-recovery.framing: Show /corpse, the coordinate link, map waypoint and V cycling in short connected steps.
corpse-recovery.expected: The recorded location helps navigation without implying the record proves current contents.

party.setup: A small party with a leader and another visible member.
party.framing: Show the roster/recruitment controls and party HUD together at a readable scale.
party.expected: The leader, membership and selected member can be identified.

nearby-alerts.setup: A known nearby name and a repeatable matching encounter.
nearby-alerts.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Show the rule editor/pattern preview, then the list and resulting notice.
nearby-alerts.expected: The glob matches expected names and produces one useful encounter notification. Click the linked alert name in chat to select the matching entity, with history interaction enabled.

chat.setup: Sample conversation with coordinates and harmless text.
chat.framing: Crop to the chat buffer and its interaction control, with a small margin of world context. Show the held modifier key.
chat.expected: With history interaction enabled, scroll back and select text. Release temporary interaction to resume live messages; demonstrate toggling interaction for longer reading.

emotes.setup: A character able to perform a standard emote, starting in combat stance.
emotes.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Show the T wheel, selection and full character gesture.
emotes.expected: The emote plays and the previous combat stance returns; release-to-dismiss can be a separate beat.

barber.setup: Your server’s barber interaction, with heritage-specific choices available.
barber.framing: Crop Barbershop with appearance choices and Apply/Cancel.
barber.expected: The choices and explicit Apply action are clear; applying is optional.

tui-gameplay.setup: An inventory task plus a quantity prompt or vendor trade.
tui-gameplay.framing: Keep changing footer actions and resulting items/quantities visible.
tui-gameplay.expected: The reader can follow a multi-step task without guessing which pane has focus.

item-appraisal.setup: An ordinary item with requirements, effects and effective combat values.
item-appraisal.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Crop the appraisal window with title and relevant fields; no test errors or missing artwork.
item-appraisal.expected: A reader can find requirements and effective values at website size.

inventory-moves.setup: Two packs, mergeable stacks and an equippable item; Native sorting selected.
inventory-moves.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Keep source and destination plus the equipment strip visible.
inventory-moves.expected: Reordering/transfers, merging and equip/unequip have clear visible results.

inventory-merge.setup: Several partially filled compatible stacks in one bag, with free space for a split.
inventory-merge.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Show the Y quantity prompt, bag Auto-merge action and completion feedback.
inventory-merge.expected: The split amount, merged stacks and freed-slot feedback are readable.

action-bars.setup: Usable item and saved loadout, plus room to clone a bar.
action-bars.framing: Use a tight component crop; retain relevant controls and enough context to follow the task. Keep drag sources, bar menu/layout controls and keyboard focus hints in view.
action-bars.expected: Binding, cloning, rotation and keyboard activation are understandable.

character-creation.setup: An unused character slot and a server on which creating a sample character is acceptable.
character-creation.framing: Show appearance, Skills & Stats and review in separate short beats.
character-creation.expected: Creation finishes on the selected new roster entry before explicit world entry.

hardware-info.setup: Launcher App settings open to graphics; machine details safe to show.
hardware-info.framing: Crop the relevant controls and Copy hardware info, without dumping the full report into the image.
hardware-info.expected: The troubleshooting action is easy to locate.

target-indicators.setup: Use several nearby creatures or objects. Start an attack, then select another object while the attack continues.
target-indicators.framing: Keep the selected outline and active combat target visible in a small world-view crop; omit unrelated HUD panels.
target-indicators.expected: Show the bold selected-object outline and the separate reticle on an active combat target.

mobile-combat.setup: Use a character with a caster, bow and ammunition in a safe fight.
mobile-combat.framing: Keep the character, targets and input display visible.
mobile-combat.expected: Show running while casting, then archery while moving, with normal movement keys visible.

minimap.setup: Use an outdoor route and a dungeon entrance.
minimap.framing: Keep the minimap readable beside the surrounding scene.
minimap.expected: Show outdoor terrain, buildings, impassable areas and elevation, then walk a winding dungeon passage and retrace part of the visible breadcrumb trail.

creature-appraisal.setup: A nearby creature and a player with a distinctive appearance; several selectable objects.
creature-appraisal.framing: Keep the appraisal model, selected-target HUD and world visible.
creature-appraisal.expected: Examine a creature or player, rotate the preview, then select another target while the original appraisal stays open. Show the available creature and player details.

selected-hud.setup: A selected player with several available actions.
selected-hud.framing: Crop only the selected-entity HUD and its open menu; keep labels readable.
selected-hud.expected: Show a tight crop of the selected name, health bar, magnifying glass and open actions menu.

chat-completion.setup: Chat input with a partial command and multiple suggestions.
chat-completion.framing: Crop to the composer and suggestions. Show syntax and descriptions, then accept a suggestion.
chat-completion.expected: Type a partial command, browse suggestions and accept one. Keep the input and suggestion list in frame.

chat-links.setup: A coordinate message and a real entity alert in the same chat buffer.
chat-links.framing: Crop to the two linked messages and the history-interaction control.
chat-links.expected: Show coordinate and entity-alert links in the chat buffer with history interaction enabled.

nearby-list.setup: Several nearby creatures or objects with distinguishable names.
nearby-list.framing: Crop the Nearby panel with an active search and a short result list.
nearby-list.expected: Show the Nearby name search, useful filters and matching results.

treestats-import.setup: Open Import from TreeStats with a recognizable public server search.
treestats-import.framing: Crop the import dialog; retain search, software, population and the import control.
treestats-import.expected: Show the TreeStats search results, server software and import action.

profile-content.setup: A sample launcher profile with its Advanced controls expanded.
profile-content.framing: Crop the content-folder choice and save-profile action; use a neutral sample path.
profile-content.expected: Show the profile’s content-folder control and the action that saves the change.

crafting-confirmation.setup: A crafting attempt with success-chance confirmation enabled.
crafting-confirmation.framing: Crop the confirmation and enough item context to identify the attempt.
crafting-confirmation.expected: Show the target, success chance and confirmation for a crafting attempt.

world-map-controls.setup: Open the World map with a recognizable location and its visibility controls.
world-map-controls.framing: Crop to the map panel; keep labels and layer controls readable.
world-map-controls.expected: Crop the World map with its visibility controls, a useful destination and pan/zoom context.

jump-preview.setup: A safe jump with a visible landing and precise jump mode active.
jump-preview.framing: Crop to the character, complete arc, landing target and power control; omit unrelated HUD panels.
jump-preview.expected: Show the landing target, trajectory arc and power control together in a focused world-view crop.

character-roster.setup: The character selection screen with a sample roster and a selected character.
character-roster.framing: Keep the roster and selected-character preview together with the enter-world control; omit unused background.
character-roster.expected: Crop the roster, selected-character preview and enter-world control.
